items.about:
Many SME manufacturing, engineering and OEM business owners are working harder than ever, yet profit is still being quietly lost through rising supplier costs, poor purchasing control, unreliable suppliers, excess stock, waste, rework and operational firefighting.

Before working with me, business owners are often:

😢 Frustrated that margins are too thin.
😢 Worried that supplier price increases are being accepted too easily.
😢 Concerned that stock is tying up cash, while shortages still disrupt production.
😢 Unsure which suppliers are underperforming and costing the business money.
😢 Fed up with poor systems, missing KPIs, and weak contracts.
😢 Concerned that poor housekeeping, processes, quality issues or H & S gaps are reducing productivity.
😢 Unhappy with manufacturing quality and efficiency.

My work is practical, commercial and hands-on. I help identify where profit is leaking, negotiate better outcomes, improve supplier performance, introduce clearer systems and support senior teams to get things done.

RLB focuses on five primary offers:

😊 The Business Value Improvement Review: A strategic review for business owners preparing for succession, investment or sale who want to maximise the value of their business before entering the market.
😊 Make More, Waste Less: For manufacturing businesses looking to improve productivity, reduce waste and increase capacity without immediately adding headcount.
😊 Solve your supply problems: Designed for businesses spending significant sums on purchased materials, services and capital equipment, that suspect hidden profit is being lost through their supply chain.
😊 Win and retain more customer business: Make your manufacturing business easier to trust, choose and keep as a long-term supplier.
😊Fractional Purchasing and Operational Support: Senior purchasing and operational leadership without the cost or commitment of a full-time senior hire.

I bring over 40 years experience in manufacturing, 25 years’ in global procurement, am a qualified member of CIPS and certified in QA Management and Consulting.

Typical areas of support include business reviews, supplier renegotiation, strategic sourcing, cost reduction, stock reduction, supplier performance improvement, 5S workplace organisation, operational improvement, H & S improvement and international sourcing.

If my offers resonate, connect with me or send me a message and let’s discuss where the hidden opportunities and profit thieves are lurking in your business.

items.about:
From jail cell to scaling multiple 8-figure businesses - my journey wasn't supposed to work out this way.

At 17, I found myself in adult jail facing serious charges. Most people's stories like mine don't end well. But that rock bottom became my foundation.

I taught myself to code, built and sold 3 tech companies, and invested in over 60 startups including Intercom, Udemy, and Unbounce. Yet my biggest success wasn't financial - it was discovering that the right guidance at the right time changes everything.

That's why I created Martell Media.

I've watched too many brilliant founders struggle with the same challenges:
• Working 80+ hours while growth flatlines
• Building a business that owns them instead of serves them
• Sacrificing health and relationships for a dream that keeps moving further away

Sound familiar?

Since 2016, I've dedicated my life to helping founders scale their companies while buying back their time. My coaching has helped clients grow from 7 to 8 figures, implement systems that let them work 20+ fewer hours weekly, and build businesses that serve their lives - not consume them.

My book "Buy Back Your Time" became a Wall Street Journal bestseller and #1 business book on Amazon because it addresses the fundamental challenge all entrepreneurs face: how to create freedom through your business, not despite it.

If you're ready to scale your company while reclaiming your life, let's connect. The entrepreneurial journey is challenging enough - you don't have to figure it out alone.

🔗 Join 300,000+ entrepreneurs receiving my weekly insights: https://bit.ly/3VMkoG
